---
title: SpatialHash
description: Spatial hashing for efficient position-based lookups and neighbor queries in 3D space.
---

SpatialHash implements a grid-based spatial indexing system for fast proximity queries. Useful for finding objects within a radius, collision detection, and range-based searches.

## Usage

```luau
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
local SpatialHash = require(ReplicatedStorage.Vendor.SpatialHash)

-- Create with cell size (tune based on typical query radius)
local sh = SpatialHash.new(10)

-- Insert objects at positions
sh:insert(enemy, enemy.Root.Position)

-- Update when object moves
sh:update(enemy, oldPosition, newPosition)

-- Query all objects within radius
for obj in sh:queryRegion(tower.Position, tower.Range) do
    tower:Target(obj)
end
```

## API Reference

### `SpatialHash.new(cellSize: number): SpatialHash`

Creates a new spatial hash with the specified cell size.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `cellSize` | `number` | Size of each grid cell (should match typical query radius) |

### `SpatialHash:insert(obj: any, pos: Vector3)`

Inserts an object at the given position.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `obj` | `any` | The object to insert |
| `pos` | `Vector3` | Position in 3D space |

### `SpatialHash:remove(obj: any, pos: Vector3)`

Removes an object from the given position.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `obj` | `any` | The object to remove |
| `pos` | `Vector3` | Position where the object was inserted |

### `SpatialHash:update(obj: any, oldPos: Vector3, newPos: Vector3)`

Updates an object's position. Only rehashes if the cell changes.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `obj` | `any` | The object to update |
| `oldPos` | `Vector3` | Previous position |
| `newPos` | `Vector3` | New position |

### `SpatialHash:queryRegion(center: Vector3, radius: number): () -> any`

Returns an iterator over all objects within the spherical region.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `center` | `Vector3` | Center of query sphere |
| `radius` | `number` | Radius of query sphere |

Returns: Iterator function that yields objects within range.

## Example: Tower Defense Targeting

```luau
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
local SpatialHash = require(ReplicatedStorage.Vendor.SpatialHash)

local enemyHash = SpatialHash.new(50)  -- 50-stud cells

-- Enemy spawning
local function onEnemySpawned(enemy: Model)
    local pos = enemy.Root.Position
    enemyHash:insert(enemy, pos)

    -- Track movement
    local connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        local newPos = enemy.Root.Position
        if (newPos - pos).Magnitude > 1 then
            enemyHash:update(enemy, pos, newPos)
            pos = newPos
        end
    end)

    enemy.Destroying:Connect(function()
        enemyHash:remove(enemy, pos)
        connection:Disconnect()
    end)
end

-- Tower targeting
local function findTargets(tower: Model, range: number)
    local targets = {}
    for enemy in enemyHash:queryRegion(tower.Position, range) do
        table.insert(targets, enemy)
    end
    return targets
end
```

## Example: Proximity Effects

```luau
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
local SpatialHash = require(ReplicatedStorage.Vendor.SpatialHash)

local playerHash = SpatialHash.new(20)

-- Update player positions
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(plr)
    plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
        local root = char:WaitForChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local lastPos = root.Position

        playerHash:insert(plr, lastPos)

        local conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            local pos = root.Position
            if (pos - lastPos).Magnitude > 5 then
                playerHash:update(plr, lastPos, pos)
                lastPos = pos
            end
        end)

        char.Destroying:Connect(function()
            conn:Disconnect()
            playerHash:remove(plr, lastPos)
        end)
    end)
end)

-- Check for nearby players (e.g., for healing aura)
local function getNearbyPlayers(center: Vector3, radius: number)
    local nearby = {}
    for plr in playerHash:queryRegion(center, radius) do
        table.insert(nearby, plr)
    end
    return nearby
end
```

## Cell Size Guidelines

| Cell Size | Best For |
|-----------|----------|
| 10-20 | Small dense areas, melee combat |
| 30-50 | Medium range, tower defense |
| 100+ | Large open worlds, sparse objects |

Smaller cells = more precise queries but more memory overhead.
Larger cells = less memory but more false positives in queryRegion.

## Performance Notes

- `insert` and `remove` are O(1)
- `update` is O(1) if cell doesn't change, O(1) amortized if it does
- `queryRegion` checks all cells that intersect the sphere, then filters by actual distance
- Empty cells are automatically cleaned up
- Objects must have `.Root.Position` or `.Position` property for distance filtering
